description: This file defines an abstract class for generating XML in the Zend Framework's XmlRpc component. It provides methods for constructing XML elements, managing encoding, and outputting the XML content.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_GeneratorAbstract
classes.description: Abstract class providing the structure for XML generator subclasses, defining methods for opening and closing XML elements and managing output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the encoding and calls the init method.

methods.name: openElement
methods.description: Starts an XML element and optionally writes a value inside it.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the current XML content as a string.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Returns the current XML encoding string.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Gets the XML content and reinitializes the generator's internal buffer.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML as a string without the XML declaration.

methods.name: stripDeclaration
methods.description: Removes the XML declaration from a given XML string.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Abstract protected method to start an XML element.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Abstract protected method to write text data into the current XML element.

methods.name: _closeElement
methods.description: Abstract protected method to close an XML element.
